member.name: T:MudExtensions.MudCodeViewer
member.summary: Represents a component that displays formatted code snippets with syntax highlighting.
member.remarks: Use this component to present code examples or source code within a user interface, typically for documentation or demonstration purposes. The component supports syntax highlighting to improve readability.
